messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem earlier — consolidating action items for the GPU capacity / autoscale incident. Posting owners + timelines. Please ack or reassign.

ajay: Ack. I9ll take the quota backstop and spare-pool sizing work.

kenji: I9ll handle scheduler tuning: preemption thresholds, pod-priority adjustments, and slow-start tweaks.

lina: I9ll update the headroom runbooks and the on-call playbook. ETA EOD Wed.

ops-bot: Created tracker ticket PM-4723 (https://tracker.internal/PM-4723). Assigned: ajay, kenji, lina. Due: 2026-04-02.

sophia: Observed recurring pattern: daily surge window ~09:45-10:15 UTC causing ~45% headroom drop on the GPU pool. Suggest adding a 10-min rolling-average headroom alert + warm-pool bump during that window.

kenji: Agree. Proposed scheduler change to test in staging:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  preemptionThreshold: "0.6"
  slowStartDelayMs: "200"
  bufferPoolSize: "2"
```

ajay: For quota: I9ll add a reserved-GPU pool of 8 GPUs for latency-critical routes and configure a burst policy (30% of spare capacity) to avoid full headroom depletion. Command I9ll use in infra: `kubectl apply -f reserved-pool.yaml`.

ajay: reserved-pool.yaml snippet:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: reserved-gpu-pool
data:
  size: "8"
  policy: "burst-30pct"
```

lina: Runbook checklist I9ll add: warmup job on scale-up, KV cache priming step, post-scale validation query template. PR coming later today.

sophia: Timeline summary:
- Quota reserve + warm pools (owner: ajay) target: Tue 2026-04-07
- Scheduler tuning (owner: kenji) staged in canary by Thu 2026-04-09
- Runbook + playbook updates (owner: lina) PR by EOD Wed 2026-04-01
ops-bot: Recurring checkpoint created: weekly review every Monday 10:00 UTC. PM-4723 updated.

kenji: Quick question — do we want to allow cross-tenant re-routing (hosted -> dedicated) as a default fallback during surge? That masked capacity issues before but caused noisy neighbor concerns.

sophia: Decision: no cross-tenant re-routing by default. First fallback is model-variant with lower memory/latency profile, then reserved pool. Add this to routing playbook.

lina: ACK — will add policy text and update SRE checklist with the new fallback order.

ajay: I9ll run a validation: synthetic load 2x burst for 30m against the new reserved pool + scheduler config. Who can pair for the validation next Tue morning?

kenji: I can join the validation. Please send a calendar invite once scheduled.

sophia: :thumbsup: Thanks all — marking the action items in the tracker. Ping me if you hit blockers or need extra capacity for testing.
